newsitem.title: VATICAN: Italy's Cardinal Poletti dies after heart attack.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Cardinal Poletti dies after heart attack.

text.p: Cardinal Ugo Poletti, former president of the Italian Episcopal Conference and Roman Catholic vicar-general of Rome, died aged 84, the Vatican said on Tuesday.
Poletti died on Monday evening at Rome's Gemelli Hospital after a heart attack.
Born in the northern Italian town of Novara, he was named vicar-general of the diocese of Rome in 1973 and served in that position until 1991.
He also was president of the Italian Episcopal Conference, which groups the country's bishops, from 1985 to 1991. He was dean of Rome's Basilica Santa Maria Maggiore from 1991 until his death.
